methodology.cash: Closing gross plus signed swap and commission/conversion debits, scaled by broker money digits. Opening commissions are zero for this S3 cohort. Later closing cash is separately labelled.
methodology.R: Fixed original fill-to-initial-SL price distance and entry cash-risk basis, unchanged after BE.
methodology.excursions: Stored executable liquidation-side quotes: ask for these short positions. In-position MFE/MAE anchored to entry through earlier of exit/cutoff. Post-close movement anchored to exit fill and divided by broker pip size and original R.
methodology.checkpoint: Last recorded quote at/before 1h/2h/4h target with maximum six-second age; not-elapsed/stale/missing endpoints are null.
methodology.post_close: (exit,min(exit+4h,capture)] with exact elapsed duration; no interpolation. Full elapsed clock is not a certificate of uninterrupted quote capture.
methodology.touch: Original absolute SL/TP versus retained liquidation-side quotes. No hypothetical fills or full counterfactual re-entry/BE/portfolio simulation.
methodology.snapshots: Monetary marks around13:55:53 and owner books13:55:51/13:56:06 are separately timed. Three BTC closes at13:56:06 explain why cutoff positions differ from later books. Actor tracked counts are not authoritative broker inventory.
methodology.pips: XAGUSD0.01; BTCUSD0.1; ETHUSD0.1, from account-specific symbol metadata.
methodology.latest20: Last official supervisor assessment before cutoff; includes older registrations and correlated account copies, not independent validation.

verification.focused_checks: Four tests passed: arithmetic/freshness; cash/cutoff isolation; horizons/exit delay; outcomes/ownership/calendar/coverage

quote_hash_reconciliation.status: All uncompressed hashes and row counts matched

WITH d AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM trading_decisions WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND at>='2026-11-12T20:55Z' AND at<'2026-11-13T05:55Z'),
i AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM trading_intents WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND created_at>='2026-11-12T20:55Z' AND created_at<'2026-11-13T05:55Z'),
e AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM trading_events WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND received_at>='2026-11-12T20:55Z' AND received_at<'2026-11-13T05:55Z')
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
'decision_counts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT account_id,symbol,kind,reason,count(*) AS records,min(at) AS first_at,max(at) AS last_at FROM d GROUP BY account_id,symbol,kind,reason ORDER BY account_id,symbol,kind,reason) x),
'arm_events',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT id,account_id,symbol,at,reason,detail FROM d WHERE kind='s3_pullback_state' AND reason IN('armed_pullback','pullback_trigger_consumed','pullback_zone_touched','invalidated_deep_retracement_gt_61_8pct','pullback_not_reached_expired')) x),
'intents',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)) FROM i),
'event_counts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT account_id,kind,label,count(*) AS records,min(received_at) AS first_at,max(received_at) AS last_at FROM e GROUP BY account_id,kind,label) x),
'live_events',(SELECT jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(e)-'raw')||jsonb_build_object('raw_hex',encode(e.raw,'hex'))) FROM e WHERE account_id=43002148),
'latest_history',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)-'raw') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id) * FROM deal_fetches WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) ORDER BY account_id,window_to DESC,fetched_at DESC,id DESC) x),
'cutoff_balances',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id) account_id,read_at,balance,money_digits FROM trader_reads WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND read_at<'2026-11-13T05:55Z' ORDER BY account_id,read_at DESC,id DESC) x),
'latest_preparations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id,symbol,detail->>'session_open') account_id,symbol,kind,reason,at,detail FROM trading_decisions WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND kind='s3_preopen' ORDER BY account_id,symbol,detail->>'session_open',id DESC) x));
ROLLBACK;
"
r=subprocess.run(['psql','-X','-q','-A','-t','-w','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1'],input=sql,text=True,capture_output=True,env=_environment(os.environ['LIVE_MONITOR_DATABASE_URL'],12000),timeout=16)
if r.returncode:
 print(json.dumps({'error':r.stderr[:2000]}));sys.exit(1)
print(r.stdout)
